decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to put pressure on opponents quickly. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand and removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while efficiently disrupting their game plan. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help generate card advantage and maintain tempo.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle, utilizing efficient spells like Unholy Heat, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck also runs cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure smooth mana development. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive gameplay by utilizing Cascade abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent with creatures and spells. By cascading into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and deal massive amounts of damage before the opponent has a chance to react. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower to provide disruption and protection, ensuring that the aggressive strategy can continue uninterrupted.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity, Transmogrify, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. It also aims to control the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Lightning Bolt, while using Leyline Binding to disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck utilizes a mix of land-fetching cards and diverse lands to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with unexpected plays and overwhelming them with powerful creature threats.

The deck focuses on creating powerful combo plays using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty or Ziatora's Proving Ground. It utilizes a mix of control elements like Mana Leak and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces while also having burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Burst Lightning for removal and finishing off opponents. With the ability to manipulate the graveyard with Wrenn and Six and dig for combo pieces with Prismari Command, the deck is designed to surprise opponents with its creativity and explosive plays.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the opponent's board and protect its own threats. The deck utilizes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Malakir Rebirth for card advantage and resilience, while also having access to powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Fury for additional reach and removal. The inclusion of Blood Moon can help disrupt opponents' mana bases and give this deck an edge in certain matchups.

The main focus of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, Archive Trap, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter. By milling the opponent's deck, the goal is to either deck them out entirely or get them close to it, making them lose the game by not being able to draw any more cards. The deck also includes disruption spells like Drown in the Loch and Surgical Extraction to control the board and stop the opponent's game plan. The land base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Shelldock Isle to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy using hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death to protect its creatures and generate additional value. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption, aggression, and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using a combination of low-cost, high-impact spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Monastery Swiftspear, along with prowess triggers from cards like Sprite Dragon and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. With efficient removal spells like Gut Shot and Vapor Snag, along with cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Manamorphose to help dig for answers or threats, this deck is designed to be fast-paced and relentless in its assault.

This deck aims to quickly and aggressively play low-cost spells and creatures to pressure the opponent's life total. It utilizes efficient removal and counter spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast pace. The deck includes cards that can generate card advantage and filter through the deck to find key pieces. It also includes powerful threats such as Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The mana base is built to support the deck's game plan by providing the necessary colors and flexibility for casting spells.

The key idea of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Underworld Breach in combination with cards like Mishra's Bauble, Ledger Shredder, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to create a powerful engine that allows for repeated spells and graveyard manipulation. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game and protect the combo. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional value and pressure on the opponent. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's strategy and consistency.

The deck focuses on aggressive card advantage and disruption to control the board and pressure the opponent quickly. It leverages cheap and efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragons Rage Channeler, while utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the game. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to dig through the deck quickly and maintain card advantage. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat in the mid to late game. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and adaptable in order to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells that allow for cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls. The ability to cascade into key spells like Violent Outburst and Fury can lead to explosive turns that can quickly close out the game. Utilizing cards like Brazen Borrower and Seasoned Pyromancer for additional value, this deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo while utilizing the cascade mechanic to its fullest potential.

The key concept of the deck is to aggressively use cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand and board while also applying pressure. With cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice, the deck aims to protect its creatures and keep up pressure. Additionally, cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional value and ways to close out the game. The inclusion of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate helps to control the opponent's game plan and keep them on the back foot. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Blood Moon to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful spells with Cascade mechanic, enabling free spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone. By maximizing Cascade triggers with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a constant stream of threats. Utilizing a mix of instant-speed removal and disruptive spells like Force of Negation, the deck seeks to maintain control of the board while pushing through damage. The versatile mix of spells and creatures allows for flexibility in adapting to various matchups and ensuring a relentless aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of equipment cards, particularly Colossus Hammer, to equip onto creatures like Ornithopter and Inkmoth Nexus to quickly deal massive damage to the opponent. Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid help facilitate the equipping process, while Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift can search for key pieces. With the ability to create powerful threats early in the game, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive plays to secure a victory.
